list_evaluation_modules: list all evaluation modules available on the Hugging Face Hub filtered by type
list_evaluation_modules_with_details: list evaluation modules with details including name, type, community tag, and likes count
inspect_evaluation_module: inspect an evaluation module by copying its scripts to a local path for modification
list_metrics_only: list only metric evaluation modules excluding community contributions from the Hugging Face Hub
SplitsNotFoundError: raise an exception when a requested split is not found in an evaluation module
